reason: A plain 7 kg semi-automatic costs about half of this in the shop, and paying ₹22,000, or ₹28,500 with the solar kit, just for a battery feels like paying for something fancy. When the power goes the women can finish the wash by hand like they always have.
objection: Two cold-water loads on the battery won't get mud and dung out of farm clothes, so I'd be paying double for a battery that doesn't do the real job, and then I'd have to replace that battery after the warranty ends.
would_change_my_mind: If the price came down near a normal semi-automatic, around ₹13,000 to ₹14,000, and the dealer washed my muddy work clothes on battery in front of me and they came out clean.
